source_units.text: I suggest retaining the decimal place because specimen N-8 has a recorded mass of 84.2 grams.
Please put any proposed identification in a separate comment field, and leave it blank until the reviewer supplies a view.
The catalogue lists its collection depth as -3.6 metres relative to the local datum.
Keep the minus sign in the transcription.
For storage, drawer Q is the listed location of N-8.
You could ask a colleague to compare the draft label with the catalogue entry before printing.
Choose a font size you find comfortable, and keep recommendations apart from the copied entries.
Do not add an origin story or a material name just to make the label feel complete.
